hero.title: Instructions
hero.subtitle: Learn how to use Bingou! quickly and easily

1.title: 1. Installation
1.desc: Download Bingou! from Google Play or Apple App Store. Open the app on your device.

2.title: 2. Create an Account
2.desc: Create your account with a valid email and password. You must accept the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.

items.create: Create: pick a name, set prizes, share the code/QR.
items.join: Join: enter the code provided by the host.

4.title: 4. Playing Bingo
4.desc: Drawn numbers update in real time. When you complete a valid card, tap 'Call Bingo'.

5.title: 5. Winners
5.desc: The host validates bingo calls and announces winners. History remains available.
